prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Tobias Reyne for the job below.

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Andriod / ios Developer needed to customize an existing source code with our company brand and logo
It is an existing system, The name is openedx. a web based admin portal that feed an existing andriod and ios app with educational data, video courses and downloadable study materials. We need an engineer to deploy a copy of this system on our sever. And customize the open source edx andriod and ios app with our company name and logo. https://openedx.org/get-started/get-started-self-managed/ https://edx.readthedocs.io/projects/edx-installing-configuring-and-running/en/latest/installation/index.html https://docs.tutor.overhang.io/ https://github.com/openedx/edx-app-android And Here is the source code for the ios app. https://github.com/openedx/edx-app-ios
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
title: Tutor marketplace MVP
client: Brightpath Tutors
client_industry: edtech
start: 2021-10
end: 2022-02
engagement: fixed
stack:
- Next.js
- Node.js
- MongoDB
- Stripe Connect
- Twilio Video
built: A two-sided marketplace with tutor profiles, booking, video lessons and automatic
  tutor payouts.

- 300 tutors

Style:
- Open with a generic line about being passionate and hard-working.
- Mention these projects by what was built and one result each: Tutor marketplace MVP (p05).

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne — a passionate and hard-working full-stack developer with 7 years of experience.

I’m interested in helping you deploy a copy of Open edX on your server and customize the Android and iOS apps with your company name and logo. I have extensive experience working across JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, and full stack web development, along with HTML/CSS and Tailwind CSS.

One relevant project was Tutor marketplace MVP for Brightpath Tutors, where I built a two-sided edtech marketplace with tutor profiles, booking, video lessons, and automatic tutor payouts. It went live in 11 weeks.

I’d be glad to help with the setup, branding, and app customization. Will you also need the admin portal customized to match your company branding, or only the mobile apps?
